messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Financial Transactions" as it appears in the following examples.
['To get your refund, please access the IRS e-file form.', 'You are required to download the form attached to this email and submit your tax refund request.', 'I WAS ADVISED BY A CLOSE FRIEND TO TRANSFER THIS MONEY OUT OF SOUTH AFRICA INTO A FOREIGN ACCOUNT AS QUICKLY AS POSSIBLE.', 'You sent a payment of 39.00 GBP to Skype (sales@skype.com)', 'I have the opportunity of transferring the leftover funds ($15.6million) of one of my bank clients who died along with his entire family on 31 July 2000 in a plane crash.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
